summary: Submitted a source-only negative result disposing of the installSnapshot post-snapshot-log lead. installSnapshot updates lastApplied, lastSnapshot, and configuration state; getLastIndex and getLastEntry select the maximum or appropriate log/snapshot state, so a lower cached log index after compaction is not stale. A retained suffix beyond the snapshot is either consistent and usable or conflicting, in which case appendEntries deletes the conflicting suffix before storing the leader's entries, and requestVote then applies the normal last-term and last-index up-to-date rule. The source path therefore supplies a repair or compatibility guard for each retained-suffix case, and no defect is retained from this lead. Preflight is valid. The remaining execution-heavy leads are stale or delayed TimeoutNow disruption and the appendEntries StoreLogs-failure branch after suffix deletion.
